description:
V00.76 opt-in module: Nimbus JOSE+JWT-backed default implementation of
    the jSentinel-core JWT SPIs (JwtValidator, JwksClient, JwtValidatorFactory)
    plus the JwtDiagnosticContributor. Framework-neutral — no Vaadin, no REST
    framework. The JOSE-free SPI contracts and result types live in
    jSentinel-core/jwt/api; this module is the only place a JOSE library is on
    the classpath. JWT/JWKS event types are published to jSentinel-events.
